title: Welcome back, pilot
subtitle: Latest combat training upgrades are live.

features.title: Target upgrade course
features.description: Practice rings are now spaced out as target gates with visible next-reward callouts. Hit them in sequence to earn ammo, missiles, shields, and alien pulse time.

features.title: Real missile drop launch
features.description: Wing missiles now fall clear of the rail before the motor lights and guidance takes over.

features.title: Damaged UFO feedback
features.description: Alien ships show failing shield flicker, sparks, and smoke trails as their hulls degrade.

features.title: Player shields
features.description: Course targets can now recharge your shield before hull damage gets through.
